name: Lidcheck
private: Your photo stays on this device
title: An eyelid photo. A clearer next step.
intro: Check for a visible pallor signal in the lower eyelid. A photo cannot measure hemoglobin or rule out anemia.
demoDetail: This population is not supported by a validated prototype model. Any signal shown is a research demonstration.
guide: Use daylight or a bright room. Turn the flash off. Hold the phone 10 to 15 cm from the eye. Gently pull the lower lid down and look up.
eyeAlt: An eye looking up, with the lower lid gently pulled down
processing: Reading the photo on your device...
reviewDetail: The outline should follow the exposed inner lower eyelid. Retake the photo if it covers skin, the iris, or another part of the eye.
positive: Your eyelid looks paler than usual. A blood test can confirm.
negative: We found no sign of pallor in this photo. This does not rule out anemia.
inconclusive: We can't read this photo reliably. Try again in daylight with the flash off.
screening: This is a screening aid, not a diagnosis.
distribution: Light bands show model training scores for non-anemic and anemic photos. The marker shows this photo; the line spans scores from the fold models. This range is not a clinical confidence interval.
q2: Does no pallor signal rule out anemia?
a1: Only a blood test can confirm anemia.
a2: Anemia can be present even when this photo shows no pallor.
privacy: Processing happens in your browser. The photo is not uploaded or saved by this app. Retake clears the current photo from the screen.
fileError: This file could not be read. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo and try again.
cameraError: The camera could not open. Allow camera access or use Take photo instead.
eyelid: The exposed eyelid was not found reliably.
blur: The eyelid area is blurry. Hold the phone still and try again.
exposure: The eyelid is too dark or too bright. Use even daylight.
glare: Bright glare covers part of the photo. Turn off the flash and change the angle.
cohesion: The detected eyelid area is fragmented. Move closer and try again.
uncertain: The model scores are too close to the decision threshold.
studyIntro: Record measurements only after written consent. No health result is shown. Use an anonymous participant code, never a name.
studySaved: Measurements added. Take the next photo or download the study file.
studyMissing: Enter a participant code and phone model before adding measurements.
studyDuplicate: This participant, condition and shot is already recorded. Choose the next shot or condition.
aboutText: The manifest below contains the model's training source, evaluation intervals, quality thresholds and population support. Numerical performance does not establish clinical validation.
synthetic: Synthetic example. This is not a person's photo.
footer: Built for the MedBio Hackathon, Khalifa University
